usedFor: PixelBin.io holds your images, and Instagram for Business posts them through “Publish Instagram Story” after “File Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “File Created” in PixelBin.io, then “Publish Instagram Story” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A new file in PixelBin.io can become a story with no manual upload.

watchOut: “Publish Instagram Story” posts from a public URL, so the new file must be reachable that way.
